description.narrative: Liberia - Program Administration and Control - FISCAL AND PROCUREMENT AGENTS activity: Through a competitive process approved by MCC, the Government has appointed a fiscal agent (the "Fiscal Agent") to provide fiscal agent services to MCA-Liberia. The Fiscal Agent will provide a broad range of financial management services required by MCA-Liberia to implement the Program, including funds control, disbursement documentation and management, cash management and accounting. Through a competitive process approved by MCC, the Government has appointed a procurement agent (the "Procurement Agent") to provide procurement agent services to MCA-Liberia. The Procurement Agent will administer all Program and administrative procurements, and provide specified procurement appropriate activities required by MCA-Liberia to implement the Program.
Capital of Liberia, Monrovia
